name: a wave of change sweeps a grid of shapes while a label scrolls behind it
looks: A looping marquee of a repeated short label scrolls sideways across a dark field. In front of it, a tidy grid of rounded diamonds sits on a bright colour field; a wave of change ripples across the grid from one corner, each shape easing from a sharp diamond into a soft square a beat after its neighbour, with a small mono caption naming the function and the shape count.
build: grid-wave-morph: shapes on a regular grid, each one's rotation/corner-radius progress offset by ease(t - k * distanceFromOrigin); a ticker-tape-marquee strip of the repeated label loops behind on a steady linear translateX; the caption text is set once from the same constants driving the grid.
sound: A soft granular patter as the wave crosses the grid, with a faint tick as each shape settles, under a low, steady bed.
prompt: Scroll a short looping label sideways across the background, then show a tidy grid of simple shapes where a wave of transformation ripples from one corner to the other, each shape settling into its new form a beat after its neighbour, with a small caption naming the rule or function behind it.
